name: vul-server-extension
description: Analyze active code for vulnerabilities using local Python or SSH backend.

vulServer.executionMode.description: Run inference locally or on a remote backend via SSH

vulServer.pythonPath.description: Python executable used for local inference

vulServer.localScriptPath.description: Path to local inference script, relative to workspace root or absolute

vulServer.localScriptPathNormal.description: Path to local normal analysis script

vulServer.remoteScriptPath.description: Absolute path to inference script on remote backend

vulServer.remoteScriptPathNormal.description: Absolute path to remote normal analysis script

vulServer.allowSshPassword.description: Allow password auth through sshpass (fallback). Prefer SSH keys.

vulServer.serverBindHost.description: Interface for TCP server bind. Use 127.0.0.1 to block external clients.

vulServer.serverAuthToken.description: Optional shared token required for TCP server requests

vulServer.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for each inference request in milliseconds

vulServer.ragEnabled.description: Enable retrieval-augmented findings for each vulnerable line

vulServer.ragTopK.description: Number of retrieval evidence items per vulnerable line

vulServer.ragMaxLines.description: Maximum vulnerable lines to enrich with RAG findings

vulServer.ragWindow.description: Context window size around each vulnerable line

vulServer.ragCache.description: Cache RAG line-window findings during the extension session

vulServer.staticRulesEnabled.description: Enable additional static-rule vulnerability detection to improve recall without retraining models

vulServer.staticMaxFindings.description: Maximum number of static-rule findings to merge per file

vulServer.ragBudgetMs.description: Total time budget for the post-localization RAG stage in milliseconds

vulServer.cweCatalogUrl.description: CWE catalog source URL used by RAG retrieval (full MITRE catalog)

vulServer.cweCachePath.description: Optional local cache path for downloaded CWE catalog JSON

vulServer.cweRefreshHours.description: Hours before refreshing the cached CWE catalog

vulServer.llmEnabled.description: Enable LLM generation for grounded explanation and fix guidance

vulServer.llmProvider.description: LLM provider used for RAG explanation generation

vulServer.ollamaUrl.description: Local Ollama generate endpoint used for offline mode

vulServer.ollamaCloudUrl.description: Optional Ollama Cloud generate endpoint used when cloud mode is enabled

vulServer.ollamaApiKey.description: Optional API key sent as Bearer token for Ollama Cloud

vulServer.ollamaModel.description: Primary local/offline model used for grounded vulnerability guidance

vulServer.useCloudModel.description: Prefer cloud model for stronger multi-line reasoning and larger-parameter generation

vulServer.ollamaCloudModel.description: Primary cloud model used for vulnerability reasoning and patch generation

vulServer.ollamaLocalFallbacks.description: Comma-separated local fallback models (in order) for offline runs

vulServer.ollamaCloudFallbacks.description: Comma-separated cloud fallback models (in order) for higher-parameter inference

vulServer.llmTimeoutMs.description: Per-line timeout for LLM guidance generation

vulServer.llmTemperature.description: LLM generation temperature for explanation and fix suggestions

vulServer.showRawJson.description: Show full JSON response in output channel

vulServer.port.description: TCP port for the server to listen on
